premises.text: Outbreak response lacks rapid accessible diagnostics: patients wait months; dipsticks are insensitive for early detection and PCR is costly, non-portable, and slow near the patient
premises.evidence_span: Without rapid, accessible diagnostics to determine who is infected, diseases continue to spread

premises.text: FastChip is a field-ready vacuum-powered microfluidic chip that isothermally amplifies nucleic acids in microwells with smartphone optical readout in about an hour, without pumps or external lab equipment
premises.evidence_span: a field-ready, affordable, sensitive, and trackable solution

premises.text: Results are quantitative by microwell fluorescence count, with a path to multiplex disease screening on one chip
A trackable app platform logs GPS, patient info, and results for ministries of health; GTM starts as research toolkit then human diagnostic after sample prep and FDA clearance
premises.evidence_span: an app that tracks GPS data, patient info, and test results

value.text: Rapid decentralized molecular diagnostics that help fight epidemics and future outbreaks
value.evidence_span: fight epidemics with rapid molecular diagnostics
